search.query: $base_search$ | head $sample_limit$ | eval group_value=if("$group_by$"="source", source, sourcetype) | eval group_value=coalesce(group_value,"unknown") | stats count by group_value | sort group_value

$base_search$ | head $sample_limit$ | eval group_value=if("$group_by$"="source", source, sourcetype) | eval group_value=coalesce(group_value,"unknown") | eval selected_group=if(len("$selected_group$")=0,"*","$selected_group$") | eval selected_group_wrapped="|" . selected_group . "|" | where selected_group="*" OR like(selected_group_wrapped,"%|*|%") OR like(selected_group_wrapped,"%|" . group_value . "|%")
| eval is_json=if(match(_raw,"^\s*[\{\[]"),1,0) | eval is_xml=if(match(_raw,"^\s*<[^>]+>"),1,0) | rex max_match=0 field=_raw "(?:^|\s)(?<kv_pairs>[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,100}\s*=\s*(?:\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'|[^\s]+))" | eval kv_count=mvcount(kv_pairs) | eval is_kv=if(kv_count>=3,1,0) | eval has_delimiter=if(match(_raw,"[,|;\t]"),1,0) | eval is_delimited=if(is_json=0 AND is_xml=0 AND is_kv=0 AND has_delimiter=1,1,0) | eval raw_len=len(_raw) | eval raw_shape=replace(_raw,"\b\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}\b","IP") | eval raw_shape=replace(raw_shape,"\b([0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}:){2,}[0-9a-fA-F:]*\b","IP") | eval raw_shape=replace(raw_shape,"[A-Fa-f0-9]{8,}","HEX") | eval raw_shape=replace(raw_shape,"\d+","N") | eval raw_shape=trim(replace(raw_shape,"\s+"," ")) | eval structure_hint=if(is_json=1 OR is_xml=1 OR is_kv=1 OR is_delimited=1,1,0) | eval raw_hash=md5(_raw)
| eventstats count as event_count avg(structure_hint) as structure_ratio dc(raw_shape) as distinct_shapes avg(raw_len) as avg_raw_len stdev(raw_len) as stdev_raw_len dc(raw_hash) as unique_raws dc(host) as distinct_hosts dc(source) as distinct_sources values(tag) as observed_tags by group_value
| eval shape_ratio=if(event_count>0,round(distinct_shapes/event_count,4),0) | eval length_variance=if(avg_raw_len>0,round(stdev_raw_len/avg_raw_len,4),0) | eval structure_score=round(structure_ratio*100,0) | eval consistency_score=round(max(0,min(100,100-(shape_ratio*100)-(length_variance*25))),0) | eval duplicate_pct=round(if(event_count>0,(1-(unique_raws/event_count))*100,0),1) | eval host_ratio=if(event_count>0,round(distinct_hosts/event_count,4),0) | eval source_ratio=if(event_count>0,round(distinct_sources/event_count,4),0) | eval cardinality_pressure=max(shape_ratio, host_ratio, source_ratio) | eval cardinality_score=round(max(0,min(100,100-(cardinality_pressure*100))),0)
| eval observed_tags_joined=mvjoin(observed_tags,"|||") | eval group_key=group_value . "###" . event_count . "###" . observed_tags_joined . "###" . structure_score . "###" . consistency_score . "###" . distinct_shapes . "###" . shape_ratio . "###" . length_variance . "###" . duplicate_pct . "###" . host_ratio . "###" . source_ratio . "###" . cardinality_score . "###" . cardinality_pressure
| foreach * [ eval present_<<FIELD>>=if(isnotnull('<<FIELD>>'),"<<FIELD>>",null()) ]
| fields group_key present_* | untable group_key temp_field field_name | rex field=group_key "^(?<group_value>.*?)###(?<event_count>\d+)###(?<observed_tags_joined>.*?)###(?<structure_score>[-\d.]+)###(?<consistency_score>[-\d.]+)###(?<distinct_shapes>\d+)###(?<shape_ratio>[-\d.]+)###(?<length_variance>[-\d.]+)###(?<duplicate_pct>[-\d.]+)###(?<host_ratio>[-\d.]+)###(?<source_ratio>[-\d.]+)###(?<cardinality_score>[-\d.]+)###(?<cardinality_pressure>[-\d.]+)$" | eval observed_tags=split(observed_tags_joined,"|||") | eval event_count=tonumber(event_count) | eval structure_score=tonumber(structure_score) | eval consistency_score=tonumber(consistency_score) | eval distinct_shapes=tonumber(distinct_shapes) | eval shape_ratio=tonumber(shape_ratio) | eval length_variance=tonumber(length_variance) | eval duplicate_pct=tonumber(duplicate_pct) | eval host_ratio=tonumber(host_ratio) | eval source_ratio=tonumber(source_ratio) | eval cardinality_score=tonumber(cardinality_score) | eval cardinality_pressure=tonumber(cardinality_pressure)
| eval field_name=replace(field_name,"^present_","") | eval field_name=lower(field_name) | where NOT match(field_name,"^_") | where field_name!="group_value" | where field_name!="event_count" | where field_name!="observed_tags"
| stats count as field_instances values(observed_tags) as observed_tags max(event_count) as event_count max(structure_score) as structure_score max(consistency_score) as consistency_score max(distinct_shapes) as distinct_shapes max(shape_ratio) as shape_ratio max(length_variance) as length_variance max(duplicate_pct) as duplicate_pct max(host_ratio) as host_ratio max(source_ratio) as source_ratio max(cardinality_score) as cardinality_score max(cardinality_pressure) as cardinality_pressure by group_value field_name
| join type=left max=0 field_name [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | eval model_field=if(recommended=1 OR required=1,1,0) | stats values(datamodel) as datamodels max(model_field) as model_field by field_name ]
| eval in_datamodel=if(isnotnull(datamodels),1,0) | eval model_field=coalesce(model_field,0) | fields group_value field_name field_instances observed_tags event_count structure_score consistency_score distinct_shapes shape_ratio length_variance duplicate_pct host_ratio source_ratio cardinality_score cardinality_pressure datamodels in_datamodel model_field

| eval is_meta_field=if(match(field_name,"^(host|source|sourcetype|index|splunk_server|splunk_server_group|linecount|punct|eventtype|tag|group_value|datamodels|in_datamodel|model_field|structure_score|consistency_score|distinct_shapes|shape_ratio|length_variance|duplicate_pct|host_ratio|source_ratio|cardinality_score|cardinality_pressure|event_count|field_instances|observed_tags)$"),1,0) | eval fill_pct=if(is_meta_field=0 AND event_count>0,round(100*field_instances/event_count,1),null()) | stats max(structure_score) as structure_score max(consistency_score) as consistency_score max(duplicate_pct) as duplicate_pct max(cardinality_score) as cardinality_score max(cardinality_pressure) as cardinality_pressure avg(fill_pct) as avg_fill_pct max(event_count) as event_count by group_value | stats avg(structure_score) as Structure avg(consistency_score) as Consistency avg(avg_fill_pct) as parsing_quality_pct avg(cardinality_score) as cardinality_score avg(cardinality_pressure) as cardinality_pressure avg(duplicate_pct) as duplicate_pct sum(event_count) as events_sampled | eval Structure=round(Structure,0) | eval Consistency=round(Consistency,0) | eval parsing_quality_pct=round(coalesce(parsing_quality_pct,0),0) | eval cardinality_score=round(coalesce(cardinality_score,0),0) | eval cardinality_pressure_pct=round(coalesce(cardinality_pressure,0)*100,1) | eval duplicate_pct=round(coalesce(duplicate_pct,0),1) | fields Structure Consistency parsing_quality_pct cardinality_score cardinality_pressure_pct duplicate_pct events_sampled

| stats max(field_instances) as field_instances by field_name | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval in_sample=1 | fields field_name in_sample | append [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | eval scope_field=if(recommended=1 OR required=1,1,0) | where scope_field=1 | eval from_lookup=1 | fields field_name datamodel from_lookup ] | stats max(in_sample) as in_sample max(from_lookup) as from_lookup values(datamodel) as datamodels by field_name | eval matched_field=if(in_sample=1 AND from_lookup=1,1,0) | eventstats max(matched_field) as any_dm_match | where from_lookup=1 | mvexpand datamodels | rename datamodels as datamodel | eventstats max(matched_field) as model_has_evidence by datamodel | stats dc(eval(if(model_has_evidence=1,field_name,null()))) as total_scope_fields dc(eval(if(model_has_evidence=1 AND matched_field=1,field_name,null()))) as matched_scope_fields max(any_dm_match) as any_dm_match dc(eval(if(model_has_evidence=1,datamodel,null()))) as models_with_evidence | eval total_scope_fields=coalesce(total_scope_fields,0) | eval matched_scope_fields=coalesce(matched_scope_fields,0) | eval any_dm_match=coalesce(any_dm_match,0) | eval models_with_evidence=coalesce(models_with_evidence,0) | eval cim_alignment_pct=round(if(total_scope_fields>0,(matched_scope_fields/total_scope_fields)*100,0),0) | fields cim_alignment_pct matched_scope_fields total_scope_fields any_dm_match models_with_evidence

div.div: Information Nexus for investigating telemetry quality evidence across structure, consistency, CIM alignment, parsing, cardinality and duplication.

panel.title: Data Quality Summary by Data Source

div.p: What this shows: Per-source quality indicators for structure, consistency, CIM alignment, parsing fill, cardinality pressure and duplication.
How to use it: Sort by the weakest dimension or issue count to prioritise engineering review.
Read it as: These are telemetry quality indicators, not compliance or governance scores.

search.query: | eval is_meta_field=if(match(field_name,"^(host|source|sourcetype|index|splunk_server|splunk_server_group|linecount|punct|eventtype|tag)$"),1,0) | eval fill_pct=if(is_meta_field=0 AND event_count>0,round(100*field_instances/event_count,1),null()) | eval datamodels=if(isnull(datamodels),"__none__",datamodels) | mvexpand datamodels | rename datamodels as datamodel | join type=left max=0 field_name [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | eval scope_field=if(recommended=1 OR required=1,1,0) | where scope_field=1 | eval from_lookup=1 | fields field_name datamodel from_lookup ] | eval matched_scope=if(from_lookup=1,1,0) | eventstats max(matched_scope) as model_has_evidence by group_value datamodel | stats max(structure_score) as structure_score max(consistency_score) as consistency_score max(duplicate_pct) as duplicate_pct max(cardinality_score) as cardinality_score max(cardinality_pressure) as cardinality_pressure avg(fill_pct) as parsing_quality_pct max(event_count) as event_count dc(eval(if(model_has_evidence=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",field_name,null()))) as total_scope_fields dc(eval(if(model_has_evidence=1 AND matched_scope=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",field_name,null()))) as matched_scope_fields dc(eval(if(model_has_evidence=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",datamodel,null()))) as models_with_evidence by group_value | eval parsing_quality_pct=round(coalesce(parsing_quality_pct,0),0) | eval cardinality_pressure_pct=round(coalesce(cardinality_pressure,0)*100,1) | eval cim_alignment_pct=round(if(total_scope_fields>0,(matched_scope_fields/total_scope_fields)*100,0),0) | eval issue_count=0 | eval issue_count=issue_count+if(structure_score<60,1,0)+if(consistency_score<60,1,0)+if(cim_alignment_pct<40,1,0)+if(parsing_quality_pct<60,1,0)+if(cardinality_score<60,1,0)+if(duplicate_pct>=20,1,0) | eval quality_band=case(issue_count=0,"Good",issue_count<=2,"Needs Review",true(),"Poor") | rename group_value as "Data Source" | rename quality_band as "Quality Band" | rename structure_score as "Structure" | rename consistency_score as "Consistency" | rename cim_alignment_pct as "CIM Alignment %" | rename parsing_quality_pct as "Parsing Quality" | rename cardinality_score as "Cardinality" | rename cardinality_pressure_pct as "Cardinality Pressure %" | rename duplicate_pct as "Duplication %" | rename issue_count as "Quality Issue Count" | rename event_count as "Events Sampled" | rename matched_scope_fields as "Matched Scope Fields" | rename total_scope_fields as "Total Scope Fields" | rename models_with_evidence as "Matched Datamodels" | table "Data Source" "Quality Band" Structure Consistency "CIM Alignment %" "Parsing Quality" Cardinality "Cardinality Pressure %" "Duplication %" "Quality Issue Count" "Events Sampled" "Matched Scope Fields" "Total Scope Fields" "Matched Datamodels" | sort "Quality Band" - "Quality Issue Count" "Data Source"

div.p: What this shows: Specific quality concerns raised by the scoring dimensions.
How to use it: Use this as the work queue for parsing, CIM field coverage, cardinality, or duplication investigation.
Read it as: These are evidence-led indicators. They should start the engineering conversation rather than act as automated remediation instructions.

search.query: | eval is_meta_field=if(match(field_name,"^(host|source|sourcetype|index|splunk_server|splunk_server_group|linecount|punct|eventtype|tag)$"),1,0) | eval fill_pct=if(is_meta_field=0 AND event_count>0,round(100*field_instances/event_count,1),null()) | eval datamodels=if(isnull(datamodels),"__none__",datamodels) | mvexpand datamodels | rename datamodels as datamodel | join type=left max=0 field_name [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | eval scope_field=if(recommended=1 OR required=1,1,0) | where scope_field=1 | eval from_lookup=1 | fields field_name datamodel from_lookup ] | eval matched_scope=if(from_lookup=1,1,0) | eventstats max(matched_scope) as model_has_evidence by group_value datamodel | stats max(structure_score) as structure_score max(consistency_score) as consistency_score max(duplicate_pct) as duplicate_pct max(cardinality_score) as cardinality_score avg(fill_pct) as parsing_quality_pct max(event_count) as event_count dc(eval(if(model_has_evidence=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",field_name,null()))) as total_scope_fields dc(eval(if(model_has_evidence=1 AND matched_scope=1 AND datamodel!="__none__",field_name,null()))) as matched_scope_fields by group_value | eval parsing_quality_pct=round(coalesce(parsing_quality_pct,0),0) | eval cim_alignment_pct=round(if(total_scope_fields>0,(matched_scope_fields/total_scope_fields)*100,0),0) | eval issue=mvappend( if(structure_score<60,"Low structure signal: events may need parsing or onboarding review",null()), if(consistency_score<60,"High event variation: event shapes or lengths are inconsistent",null()), if(event_count<50,"Low sample size: quality confidence may be limited",null()), if(cim_alignment_pct<40,"Low CIM alignment: recommended fields for matched datamodels are incomplete",null()), if(parsing_quality_pct<60,"Low parsing quality: extracted fields are sparsely populated",null()), if(cardinality_score<60,"High cardinality pressure: shapes, hosts or sources are highly unique per event",null()), if(duplicate_pct>=20,"High duplication: many repeated raw payloads in the sample",null()) ) | eval issue_count=mvcount(issue) | where issue_count>0 | eval severity=case( mvfind(issue,"Low structure signal: events may need parsing or onboarding review")>=0,"High", mvfind(issue,"High event variation: event shapes or lengths are inconsistent")>=0,"High", mvfind(issue,"Low CIM alignment: recommended fields for matched datamodels are incomplete")>=0,"High", mvfind(issue,"High duplication: many repeated raw payloads in the sample")>=0,"High", true(),"Medium" ) | eval issue=mvjoin(mvsort(issue),"; ") | rename group_value as "Data Source" | rename issue as "Issues" | rename structure_score as "Structure" | rename consistency_score as "Consistency" | rename cim_alignment_pct as "CIM Alignment %" | rename parsing_quality_pct as "Parsing Quality" | rename cardinality_score as "Cardinality" | rename duplicate_pct as "Duplication %" | rename event_count as "Events Sampled" | table "Data Source" severity Issues Structure Consistency "CIM Alignment %" "Parsing Quality" Cardinality "Duplication %" "Events Sampled" | sort severity "Data Source"

div.p: What this shows: Recommended-field matches and related CIM tags for datamodels detected in the selected data.
How to use it: Use this to see which models contribute to CIM Alignment and whether coverage tags are present.
Read it as: Field evidence and tag evidence are related but separate. Governance mappings are reviewed on the Governance dashboards.

search.query: | where model_field=1 OR in_datamodel=1 | mvexpand datamodels | rename datamodels as datamodel | join type=inner max=0 field_name [ | inputlookup datamodel_fields_lookup | eval field_name=lower(trim(field_name)) | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval recommended=if(recommended="true" OR recommended=1,1,0) | eval required=if(required="true" OR required=1,1,0) | where recommended=1 OR required=1 | fields field_name datamodel ] | stats dc(field_name) as matched_fields values(field_name) as field_examples values(observed_tags) as observed_tags max(event_count) as event_count by group_value datamodel | join type=left max=0 datamodel [ | inputlookup cim_datamodel_tags_lookup | eval datamodel=trim(datamodel) | eval expected_tag=lower(trim(expected_tag)) | eval tag_role=lower(trim(coalesce(tag_role,"supporting"))) | eval coverage_set=coalesce(coverage_set,"_default") | where tag_role="top_level" | fields datamodel expected_tag tag_role coverage_set ] | eval observed_tags=mvmap(observed_tags, lower(trim(observed_tags))) | eval tag_hit=if(isnotnull(expected_tag) AND mvfind(observed_tags, expected_tag)>=0,1,0) | eval has_tag_mapping=if(isnotnull(expected_tag),1,0) | stats min(eval(if(tag_role="top_level",tag_hit,null()))) as top_ok max(has_tag_mapping) as has_tag_mapping values(eval(if(tag_role="top_level",expected_tag,null()))) as related_cim_tags max(matched_fields) as matched_fields values(field_examples) as field_examples values(observed_tags) as observed_tags max(event_count) as event_count by group_value datamodel coverage_set | eval set_complete=if(isnull(top_ok),0,if(top_ok=1,1,0)) | stats max(matched_fields) as matched_fields values(field_examples) as field_examples values(observed_tags) as observed_tags values(related_cim_tags) as related_cim_tags max(has_tag_mapping) as has_tag_mapping max(set_complete) as coverage_complete max(event_count) as event_count by group_value datamodel | eval tag_status=case( has_tag_mapping=0,"No related CIM tag mapping", coverage_complete=1,"Coverage tags observed", true(),"Coverage tags not observed" ) | eval related_cim_tags=if(isnull(related_cim_tags),"",mvjoin(mvsort(mvdedup(related_cim_tags)),", ")) | eval observed_tags=if(isnull(observed_tags),"",mvjoin(mvsort(mvdedup(observed_tags)),", ")) | eval field_examples=mvjoin(mvsort(mvdedup(field_examples)),", ") | rename group_value as "Data Source" | rename datamodel as "Datamodel" | rename matched_fields as "Matched Recommended Fields" | rename tag_status as "Coverage Tag Status" | rename related_cim_tags as "Related CIM Tags" | rename observed_tags as "Observed Tags" | rename field_examples as "Matched Field Examples" | rename event_count as "Events Analysed" | table "Data Source" Datamodel "Matched Recommended Fields" "Coverage Tag Status" "Related CIM Tags" "Observed Tags" "Matched Field Examples" "Events Analysed" | sort "Data Source" - "Matched Recommended Fields" Datamodel
